x0.meaning: stored to stack, used later as container/connection handle
x0.evidence: entry value preserved at [sp,#8], accessed after option processing

x1.evidence: saved to x19, then used as x0 in CFDictionaryGetValue calls (0x262ec+)

x2.note: not referenced in the function body

argument_consumption_map.consumption_method: register-transfer tracking: mov x19,x1 = READ of entry x1

CRITICAL_ARGUMENT_MAP_CORRECTION.previous_claim: x0 and x1 are REDEFINED_BEFORE_READ (not inputs)
CRITICAL_ARGUMENT_MAP_CORRECTION.corrected_finding: Entry x1 IS an input. It is saved to callee-saved register x19 at instruction 0x262bc (mov x19, x1) BEFORE x1 is overwritten with local values. Entry x0 is also an input, stored to [sp,#8] at 0x262c0. The saved x19 (entry x1) is then used as the dictionary for repeated CFDictionaryGetValue calls starting at 0x262ec. The argument consumption map failed to track register-to-register transfers as reads of the entry value.
CRITICAL_ARGUMENT_MAP_CORRECTION.engine_bug: The argument consumption map engine did not recognize mov x19,x1 as a READ of entry x1. It only checked if the destination register matched the tracked register, missing that the SOURCE operand (x1) was the entry value being consumed.
